question: Should `OutboundMediaLoadOptions.optimizeImages` and `transcodeAudioBufferToOpus.maxDurationSeconds` be accepted as permanent shared Plugin SDK contracts for the WhatsApp media refactor?
rationale: The implementation consolidates duplicated WhatsApp behavior, but the two additions extend reusable SDK helpers rather than remaining entirely within the channel plugin.

options.title: Accept the focused SDK additions
options.body: Confirm both options as stable shared media-helper behavior and proceed with the refactor's normal merge review.

options.title: Keep the additional behavior plugin-local
options.body: Redesign the change to avoid expanding the shared SDK if those options should not become part of its long-term contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused SDK additions
recommendation.body: Confirm both options as stable shared media-helper behavior and proceed with the refactor's normal merge review.
